name: Clairvest Group Inc.
summary: Clairvest Group Inc. is a private equity firm specializing in mid-market, growth equity investments, buyouts, industry consolidation and acquisitions. It seeks to invest in small and mid-sized gaming (land and online) and casinos, restaurants, healthcare, experience economy, equipment rental, medical practice management, waste management, aerospace, architecture and engineering & consulting (AEC), agriculture, oil and gas field services, dental, life science and services, renewable energy, co-packing / private label manufacturing, defense, building products, environmental services, healthcare IT, interactive home entertainment, distribution, extermination and pest control, sanitary services,…
